title: Pick a random movie from OMDB and print…

messages.content:
🎬 **Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse** (2018)

⏱️ Runtime: 117 minutes
🎭 Genres: Animation, Action, Adventure
🎥 Director: Bob Persichetti, Peter Ramsey, Rodney Rothman
⭐ IMDb Rating: 8.4/10

📖 Plot: Teen Miles Morales becomes the Spider-Man of his universe and must join with five spider-powered individuals from other dimensions to stop a threat for all realities.

A visually stunning, critically acclaimed animated adventure that reinvented the superhero genre — well worth a watch!

🎬 **The Pianist** (2003)

⏱ Runtime: 150 minutes
🎭 Genres: Biography, Drama, Music
🎥 Director: Roman Polanski
⭐ IMDb Rating: 8.5/10

📖 Plot: During WWII, acclaimed Polish musician Wladyslaw faces various struggles as he loses contact with his family. As the situation worsens, he hides in the ruins of Warsaw in order to survive.

A powerful, critically acclaimed film starring Adrien Brody — well worth a watch!

**Apocalypse Now** (1979) – 147 min | Drama, Mystery, War
Directed by Francis Ford Coppola | Starring Martin Sheen, Marlon Brando, Robert Duvall

⭐ IMDb Rating: 8.4/10

📖 Plot: A U.S. Army officer serving in Vietnam is tasked with assassinating a renegade Special Forces Colonel who sees himself as a god.

A towering war epic that plunges deep into the madness of Vietnam and the human psyche—a true classic worth revisiting!

🎬 **Spider-Man: Homecoming** (2017)

⏱️ Runtime: 133 minutes
🎭 Genres: Action, Adventure, Sci-Fi
🎥 Director: Jon Watts
⭐ IMDb Rating: 7.4/10

📖 Plot: Peter Parker tries to stop Adrian 'The Vulture' Toomes from selling weapons made with advanced Chitauri technology while trying to balance his life as an ordinary high school student.

Starring Tom Holland, Michael Keaton, and Robert Downey Jr. — a fun, high-flying entry that also scored 92% on Rotten Tomatoes! 🕷️
